evidence_classes: Report behavioral relation families/instances, exact oracle rows, fatal controls and executables separately. Any fatal guard breach voids the run.
mutant_acceptance: Each modified source copy must compile and reach a named expected fixture failure, not merely fail compilation.
hard_semantics: The native serialized receive pipeline alone owns admitted FIFO records, occupancy, exact rational credit, clock consumption and service accounting. The C facade and device expose projections only.

A final debit and an actually admitted replacement at the exact same timestamp form one boundary. Earned remainder is retained for that replacement, which remains ineligible until the strictly following configured clock.

A positive-duration empty interval, including one picosecond off-grid, clears earned remainder. Arbitrary monotone picosecond arrivals retain their existing domain and are never rounded to the service grid.
An empty FIFO retains zero live credit. A private same-time candidate has no occupancy, scheduled event, refill or pending physical work. It expires on any positive empty advance.

Candidate credit may move once only after all envelope, horizon, capacity, rate and push gates succeed. Rejected offers do not activate live credit; a later valid admission at the same timestamp may still consume the candidate. Admitted sequence or duplicate rejection retains its existing ingress charge.

Repeated progress at the same time and read-only event, counter and invariant queries cannot accrue or debit twice. Existing inclusive service-before-admission ordering and strict later-clock eligibility remain unchanged.

Partial terminal-horizon service retains applied-byte accounting and reports the existing pending error; neither NO_EVENT nor an invented following clock is allowed. A fully drained terminal head does not authorize an unrepresentable successor.
Original C ABI1 layouts, defaults and traces stay exact. No configuration or service version, Fluid semantics, transport window, receive capacity, rate, band or arrival stream is tuned.
